title: 第21章 将军百战死第22章 我丢掉了丰田县城
slug: 骂我朝廷鹰犬我乃大秦武圣
content_zh:
看着城门之前的张远横刀长啸，端坐马上的欧阳旭眼角抽动。
唯有真正的军人，才能感应到这种战场上的荣耀。
生死无悔，马革裹尸。
“杀——”
双腿一磕马腹，黑色战骑瞬间冲出。
欧阳旭手中长枪抬起，借战骑前冲之力，朝着张远当胸刺出。
他的枪长一丈五尺，枪锋侧面有月牙小枝，说是枪，该是戟。
“当——”
张远手中刀柄挡在胸前，抵住月牙锋刃。
枪身之上的巨力传来，张远身形不受控制的往后退出三丈。
他的手臂筋骨崩裂，口中鲜血喷出。
欧阳旭这一枪，借战马奔踏之力，以先天真元加持，其中力量超过三牛之劲！
一击六千斤，便是山石也会被崩碎。
而且，欧阳旭分明是修了极高明的功法，一枪刺出，力量穿透而凝聚，所有劲力在枪锋刺出瞬间迸发。
“噗——”
停住身形的张远口中再一口鲜血喷涌而出。
欧阳旭的奔骑一枪，不但伤了张远的双臂，连五脏六腑也被震伤。
“还以为你真的是先天境。”一扯缰绳，战骑前足扬起，欧阳旭长枪指向张远，“不过以你年岁，能在我手下一枪不死，也足以自傲了。”
战骑暴躁踢踏，左右踏足，似乎对没能一击斩杀张远表达不满。
欧阳旭一手轻拍座下战骑，抬手枪锋一挥。

游弋在一旁的战骑轰然而行，手中弯刀扬起，向着张远冲去。
不需要挥刀，只要借马力冲过去，刀锋就能将张远的头颅斩下。
张远立在原地，身上气血激荡。
他的双臂此时已经不能用力。
脑海之中，一颗妖气珠子崩碎，一颗真元珠子碎散，青灰两道力量急速修补他被震裂的手臂筋骨。
可是这修补的速度，比不上那冲骑而至的奔马，比不上那锋利的弯刀。
只要刀锋划过，他的脑袋就会高高扬起，带着一捧热血喷洒，他的身躯会被撞飞，跌落在守护了三个月的丰田县城城门之外。
将军百战死。
他张远还没有资格称将军。
抬头，张远看向奔踏而来的战马。
他能看到覆盖面甲的骑兵双目之中杀意。
森寒，冰凉，仿若只是来斩杀一只蝼蚁。
他张远，是蝼蚁吗？
无法挥刀的张远，是不是蝼蚁？
“杀——”
长刀刀柄扎入城门外坚实的泥土，张远空出双手，双拳握紧。
content_en:
Watching Zhang Yuan roaring with his sword in front of the city gate, Ouyang Xu's eyes twitched as he sat upright on his horse.
Only true soldiers can sense this kind of glory on the battlefield.
Life and death without regrets, wrapped in horse leather.
"Kill——"
His legs knocked against the horse's belly, and the black warrior rushed out instantly.
Ouyang Xu raised the spear in his hand and stabbed Zhang Yuan in the chest with the help of the warrior's forward charge.
His spear is one foot and five feet long, with a crescent twig on the side of the spear. It is said to be a spear, but it should be a halberd.
"When——"
Zhang Yuan held the hilt of the knife in front of his chest, against the crescent blade.
A huge force came from the gun body, and Zhang Yuan retreated three feet uncontrollably.
The muscles in his arms cracked and blood spurted out of his mouth.
Ouyang Xu's shot was powered by the galloping war horse and blessed with innate true energy. Its power exceeded the strength of three oxen!
A blow of six thousand kilograms will break even the rocks.
Moreover, Ouyang Xu had clearly practiced extremely high-level skills. When he thrust out a spear, his power penetrated and condensed, and all his strength burst out the moment the spear tip was thrust out.
"Pfft——"
Another mouthful of blood spurted out from Zhang Yuan's mouth as he stopped.
Ouyang Xu's gunshot not only injured Zhang Yuan's arms, but also shocked his internal organs.
"I thought you were really in the innate realm." Pulling the reins, the front legs of the war horse were raised, and Ouyang Xu pointed his spear at Zhang Yuan, "But at your age, you are proud enough to be able to survive a single shot from me."
The war knight kicked violently, stepping left and right, seeming to express his dissatisfaction with not being able to kill Zhang Yuan with one blow.
Ouyang Xu patted the knight under his seat with one hand, raised his pistol and waved it.
The war cavalry cruising aside roared forward, raising the scimitar in its hand, and rushed towards Zhang Yuan.
There is no need to swing the knife, just use the power to rush over, and the blade can cut off Zhang Yuan's head.
Zhang Yuan stood on the spot, with blood surging in his body.
His arms could no longer use force at this time.
In his mind, a monster energy bead shattered and a true energy bead shattered. The two forces of green and gray quickly repaired the broken arm muscles.
However, the speed of repair was not as fast as the rushing horse or the sharp scimitar.
As long as the blade cuts across, his head will be raised high, with a handful of hot blood spraying out, his body will be knocked away, and he will fall outside the gate of Toyota County that has been guarded for three months.
Generals died in hundreds of battles.
Zhang Yuan is not qualified to be called a general.
Raising his head, Zhang Yuan looked at the galloping horses.
He could see the murderous intent in the eyes of the cavalrymen covered with masks.
It's cold and cold, as if it's just killing an ant.
Is Zhang Yuan an ant?
Is Zhang Yuan, who cannot swing a sword, an ant?
"Kill——"
The handle of the long knife pierced the solid soil outside the city gate. Zhang Yuan freed his hands and clenched his fists.
